description: Read a doc, presentation or storyboard as it is now, including edits the team made in the app. A doc comes back as Markdown and a presentation as its JSON. A storyboard comes back as its script: treatment, cast, each film's shots with seconds, action and lines, and a link to each picked frame. An <evidence_card/> marker is an exhibit the doc shows (about and url say what it is): keep or move its markers when you rewrite the text, edit its caption there, and leave them out to drop it. Copied into another doc with create_doc or update_doc, a marker brings its exhibit along.

doc_id.description: A doc id from get_task or list_space.

prompts.description: A storyboard only: also return each shot's frame prompt.

name: read_doc
title: Read doc
